The major cluster in ccRCC, ccRCC-AVR-1, was similar to the AVR population in benign tissue, while the minor cluster, ccRCC-AVR-2, specifically expressed ACKR1 and SELP ( SI Appendix , Fig. S2 B and Fig. 5 B ), thereby implying that the feeder vessels of tumor vasculature may be most composed of PLVAP + AVR1-rich vessels.

The major cluster in ccRCC, ccRCC-AVR-1, was similar to the AVR population in benign tissue, while the minor cluster, ccRCC-AVR-2, specifically expressed ACKR1 and SELP ( SI Appendix , Fig. S2 B and Fig. 5 B ), thereby implying that the feeder vessels of tumor vasculature may be most composed of PLVAP + AVR1-rich vessels.
